name: Gun Tinkerer (Artificer Archetype)
body:
A gun tinkerer is an artificer that applies their understanding of magical items into guns.

Weapon and Armor Proficiencies

Gun tinkerers proficient with guns in addition to their normal weapon and armor proficiencies. This ability modifies the gun tinkerer’s weapon and armor proficiencies.

Gunsmith: A gun tinkerer gains a battered gun identical to the one gained by a 1st level gunslinger, as well as the Gunsmithing feat (including the ability to restore their battered gun as if they were a gunslinger). As a standard action, the gun tinkerer can expend one of their prepared spells to remove the broken condition from a single firearm they are currently wielding, as long as that condition was gained from a misfire. This replaces scribe scroll and trapfinding.

Cartridge Crafter (Ex)

At 2nd level, a gun tinkerer gains a bonus to Craft checks to make ammunition equal to 1/2 their class level. Additionally, any DC of an effect created by such ammunition, such as a flare cartridge, is increased to 10 + 1/2 the gun tinkerer’s class level + their Intelligence modifier. This ability replaces the bonus item creation feat gained at 2nd level.

Quick Operation (Ex)

At 3rd level, a gun tinkerer gains Rapid Reload as a bonus feat, though they must select a type of firearm for this feat. This ability replaces the bonus metamagic feat gained at 3rd level.

Firearm Modifications (Ex)

At 7th level, a gun tinkerer applies some modifications to their firearm of their own design. The changes made to the firearm are permanent and have a gold piece cost for materials. It takes about 1 day’s worth of work to complete a modification. The modification only applies to the firearm you gained through the gunsmith ability and is chosen from the list below. You gain additional modifications at 9th, 11th, 13th, 15th, and 19th levels.

Ammunition Magazine-You have built a magazine of ammunition for your firearm. It can hold up to 3 rounds and reloading is a swift action, until you need to change out the magazine. You can have up to 5 prepared magazines of ammunition. This can be selected multiple times to increase the ammo capacity of the magazine by 2 each time. The firearm can be reloaded as normal after the magazines are spent. If the firearm has multiple barrels with which to fire, the ammunition magazine only applies to one barrel, but you can select this modification again to add to other barrels without increasing the magazine size.
Enhanced Optics-The range of your firearm, and thus the touch range, is doubled.
Increased Caliber-The damage dice of your firearm increases by 1 step.
Overhauled Mechanisms-Your firearm is now masterwork.
Quickdraw Mechanism-You can draw or stow the firearm as a free action.
Reduced Climb-You have built in ports to reduce muzzle climb when making multiple shots. The penalty for attacks after the first attack, usually -5, is reduced to -4. This cannot be used in conjunction with the suppressor.
Self-cleaning Mechanism-You have created a mechanism that keeps your firearm from malfunctioning. You reduce the misfire value of the firearm by 1 (to a minimum of 0) before any misfire chance is added by the ammunition used.
Suppressor-A creature must make a DC 18 Perception check to hear the firearm being fired. This is modified by distance as well. While the suppressor is active, the touch range of the firearm is halved. Affixing and removing the suppressor on your firearm is a move action.

This ability replaces metamagic spell completion, metamagic spell trigger, and the bonus metamagic feats gained at 9th and 15th levels.
